# Insights → Log — `/insights`

**Source:** `src/pages/InsightsLog.tsx` + `src/components/insights/ROSCSummaryCard.tsx`
**Personas:** Persona-neutral — a display surface for AI output already generated by other screens (Journal Analysis Wizard, Deep Pattern Analysis, Workbook analysis). Relevant to whichever persona triggered the underlying analysis.
**Tier:** Free — no gate on this screen. Gating already happened upstream, at whichever flow generated each `insights/{id}` document.
**Zero-knowledge status:** Reads/writes `insights/{id}` (root collection) — fully unencrypted, per CLAUDE.md's table. Also mounts `ROSCSummaryCard`, which reads `users/{uid}/rosc_assessments` (partially encrypted — see `docs/screens/insights/README.md`).

## What it does

A single, reverse-chronological archive ("Daily analysis and coaching history") of every AI-generated insight the user has accumulated — Journal Analysis Wizard comparative/deep-pattern runs and Workbook AI analyses both save here. A filter chip row (`all` / `journal` / `workbook`) narrows the list client-side; this is **not** three separate tabs or routes — `filter` is local component state (`useState<'all' | 'journal' | 'workbook'>`), and switching it re-filters an already-fetched array, no refetch. A `ROSCSummaryCard` (the Recovery Capital teaser — latest snapshot + a link into `/insights/rosc`) is mounted above the filter row, so this screen is also the entry point into the ROSC sub-app.

## How it works

### Data fetch
`loadData()` calls `getInsightHistory(user.uid)` (`src/lib/insights.ts`) once on mount — a single `getDocs` query (`insights` where `uid == uid`, `orderBy('createdAt', 'desc')`), not a TanStack Query hook (unlike almost every other Firestore read in the app — see Known gaps). Mock accounts (`user.email` ending in `.mock`) short-circuit to `getMockInsights(user.email)` instead of hitting Firestore.

### Grouping & the collapsible timeline
`filteredInsights` (post-chip-filter) is passed through `groupItemsByYearAndMonth` (`src/lib/grouping.ts`) to build a `{year: {monthIndex: insight[]}}` tree, rendered as nested disclosure sections — years default-collapsed except the current year, months default-collapsed except the current month (`expandedYears`/`expandedMonths` state, seeded from `new Date()` at mount). Each year header shows a total count; each month header shows its own count and is sticky (`sticky top-0`) while scrolled.

### Insight cards
Each insight renders as a `@headlessui/react` `<Disclosure>` — collapsed shows an icon (book for `journal`, academic-cap for `workbook`), `scope_context` (or a generic "Journal Insight"/"Workbook Insight" fallback if absent), the date, and — if present — a `relapse_risk_level` badge (Low/Moderate/High/Critical, color-coded) and a `trajectory` badge. Expanded reveals `summary` plus a responsive "Bento Grid" of up to six conditionally-shown blocks (`InsightBlock` — a small reusable renderer): Understanding, Strengths & Wins, Risk Analysis, Key Themes, Hidden Links, Triggers. Because `InsightPayload` is polymorphic across the journal/workbook analysis flows that write it, three small accessor helpers (`getActions`, `getStrengths`, `getRisks`) normalize differently-named fields from different source flows into one shape — e.g. `getStrengths` falls back from `strengths` to `pillars.growth` to `pillars.emotional_resonance` depending on which flow produced the doc.

### Add to Tasks
Each expanded card's "Recommended Strategy" section lists up to 3 actions (`getActions(insight).slice(0, 3)`), each with a one-tap "Add to Tasks" button. `handleAddToTasks` calls `useTaskOperations().addTask()` with `source: 'ai'`, `priority: 'Medium'`, a 7-day due date, and `aiMeta: { sourceRef: insight.id }`. Per `docs/screens/tasks/today.md`, a `sourceRef` that doesn't start with `workbook:` routes the resulting task's "See insight →" deep-link generically to `/insights` (not to this specific insight — `insight.id` alone isn't resolvable back to a scroll position in this timeline). Once added, the button flips to a checkmark and disables (`addedActions`, a session-only `Set` — reopening the page resets which actions show as already-added).

## Data model

`insights/{id}` (root collection, `src/lib/insights.ts`) — **fully unencrypted**, confirmed against `saveInsight()`'s plain `addDoc`:

| Field | Encrypted? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `uid` | ❌ Plaintext | |
| `createdAt` | ❌ Plaintext | Firestore `Timestamp` |
| `type` | ❌ Plaintext | `'journal' \| 'workbook'` |
| `scope_context` | ❌ Plaintext | Header label; falls back to a generic string if absent |
| `summary` | ❌ Plaintext | AI narrative |
| `pillars.understanding` / `.blind_spots` | ❌ Plaintext | Present on both variants |
| `pillars.growth` (journal) / `pillars.emotional_resonance` (workbook) | ❌ Plaintext | The one field name that differs by `type` — `InsightsLog.tsx`'s `getStrengths()` reads both |
| `suggested_actions` / `actionableSteps` / `actionable_advice` | ❌ Plaintext | Three possible field names across source flows — `getActions()` normalizes |
| `risks`, `strengths`, `key_themes`, `hidden_correlations`, `core_triggers` | ❌ Plaintext | All optional, all arrays |
| `relapse_risk_level`, `trajectory`, `emotional_velocity` | ❌ Plaintext | Optional badges |

This matches CLAUDE.md's schema table (`insights/{id}` — ❌ No) exactly. Firestore rules (`firestore.rules`) gate `insights/{insightId}` as owner-create / owner-read-update-delete, consistent with a root collection rather than a `users/{uid}` subcollection.

## Gating & limits

None on this screen. `useTaskOperations().addTask()` has no rate limit either. (The AI calls that *produced* these insights were already gated upstream — see the relevant flow's own doc under `docs/screens/journal/`.)

## Known gaps / debt

- `getInsightHistory()` is a bare `getDocs` call in a `useState`/`useEffect`, not a TanStack Query hook — inconsistent with CLAUDE.md's "ALL Firestore reads/writes go through useQuery/useMutation" rule. No caching, no built-in refetch/invalidation; a newly-created insight only appears after a full remount of this page.
- `addedActions` (which task-add buttons show as already-added) is session-only local state, not persisted — matches the same pattern already noted as a non-issue in the ROSC monthly-action-items addendum, but worth naming here too since it's the same UX shape.
- A `sourceRef` of a bare `insight.id` can't deep-link a task back to its originating insight in this timeline (no anchor/scroll-to); see `docs/screens/tasks/today.md`'s Known gaps for the broader `aiMeta` inconsistency across all AI-task callers.
